fact: 18.7 per cent of the population of Sierra Leone used the internet in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
21.5 per cent of the population of Sierra Leone used the internet in 2022, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
23.7 per cent of the population of Sierra Leone used the internet in 2023, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
25.1 per cent of the population of Sierra Leone used the internet in 2024, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
